hypothesis: An optimistic, phase-conditioned n-tuple public-state value function, trained on-policy with a three-delta forward view and used by a bounded two-rise representative-outcome rollout, can learn survival and chain-building structure that a depth-4 handcrafted evaluator misses.

valueInputs: moves remaining before the next row rise
forbidden: history not represented by the public state

training.selection: No intermediate checkpoint selection. Stop exactly at 50m for the mandatory continuation gate; if it passes, resume the same checkpoint to exactly 100m.
training.resume: Checkpoint v3 preserves the active game, pending forward views, model, temporal-coherence accumulators, transition cursor, and full compile-time training contract.

search.description: Deterministic bounded representative-outcome rollout; this is an approximation, not exact expectiminimax.
